title: Render profile and interaction profile are separate axes
summary: Renderer capability/display profiles such as compact-touch or large-fine are separate from semantic interaction profiles such as HUMAN_VISUAL and AI_AGENT_OPTIMISED. Mixing them causes incorrect definition selection and weakens the authority model.
invariants: Render profile is selected from capability/display facts and controls concrete renderer preparation.
Interaction profile is a server-authoritative semantic presentation projection of the same application.
Selecting an AI/machine interaction profile never creates a second business API or different transaction authority.
Browser capability claims may select among server-defined render profiles but never arbitrary executable code.

provenance.claim: Server explicitly selects renderer capability profile independently of HUMAN_VISUAL/AI_AGENT_OPTIMISED.
Same immutable release may switch semantic interaction profile without separate bot API.
Reconciled JS separates semantic interaction profile from renderer profile.
